metric_input: Decoded published PCM16 WAVs, independently fitted per prediction

alignment.comparison: Same target time interval, not a matched-prediction-length ablation

selection.purpose: Author-selected qualitative illustration, not a population average

audio.quantization: round(gain*x*32768); decode as int16/32768; no dither
audio.changes: Time alignment, excerpt selection, one shared gain, PCM16 quantization; predictions are saved model outputs

figure.reference: Maximum STFT magnitude across all three exported WAVs
